version.changelog: Restore direct transcript-to-WorkoutSummary processing and remove the separate distillation/synthesis workflow.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent workout-summary helper, with a purpose-aligned but noteworthy optional GitHub dataset download/cache and optional cloud transcription path.

dimensions.detail: Network use is purpose-aligned but should be understood: transcription may use Groq/OpenAI-compatible APIs only when configured or chosen, and the exercise matcher can download a public GitHub dataset for name normalization.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is simple skill content plus two Python helper scripts using standard-library functionality; I found no installer, package-manager hooks, startup registration, or automatic execution mechanism.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions include clear guardrails: local by default, save only when asked, do not create remote sessions or indexes unless explicitly requested, do not embed API keys, and do not invent workout or medical details.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The exercise matcher caches the public exercise dataset under the user's home cache directory when no local dataset is provided; this is limited persistence and does not index or store user workout transcripts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe summarizing user-provided strength-training recordings or transcripts, calculating durations, extracting sets/reps from the transcript, and standardizing exercise names; I found no evidence that it fabricates summaries from unrelated data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should be comfortable with two optional external paths: cloud transcription can upload workout audio to the selected provider if configured, and the matching helper may download/cache a public exercise dataset from GitHub unless a local dataset is supplied. Use an existing transcript or local Whisper for the most local workflow, and pass a vetted local dataset if outbound GitHub access is not acceptable.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The scanner's concern about replacing user-derived summaries with remote dataset metadata is not supported by the artifact: the skill repeatedly requires deriving totals, exercises, sets/reps, and notes from the transcript and warns not to invent details. Dataset use is for exercise-name standardization.
[SDI-1] expected: The helper really can fetch and persistently cache the GitHub exercise JSON when no local dataset is present, but the behavior is documented in the workflow reference, limited to a public dataset, and does not send transcript candidates or user audio to GitHub.
[SDI-2] expected: The default GitHub raw URL is a real remote dependency and is not pinned, which users should consider in restricted environments, but it is coherent with the stated exercise-normalization feature rather than hidden unrelated capability.
